'''Peter Victor Hobbs''' (1936–2005) was a British-born professor of [[atmospheric science]]s and director of the Cloud and Aerosol Research Group at the [[University of Washington]]. His research interests were in the physics and chemistry of the atmosphere, focusing on the roles played by aerosols, clouds, and precipitation. He authored over 250 peer-reviewed papers, authored four books, and edited three books. He was the coauthor with [[John Michael Wallace]] of what is generally considered the standard introductory textbook in the field: ''Atmospheric Science: An Introductory Survey''.
